decision.summary: A transient multi-axis offset begins ~452 with a pronounced N jump (+~6 MAD), accompanied by smaller E (negative) and U (positive) transients. The event lacks a clear return within the allowed context (410–495); N remains elevated afterward without reversal, so status is uncertain. No other temporary offsets are confirmed in this window.

intervals.observation: N shows a sharp multi-sample upward excursion (~+6 MAD) beginning near index 452, peaking around 455–456, and remaining elevated through 460; E and U exhibit smaller correlated transients (E: ~−1 to −2 MAD, U: ~+0.5 to +1 MAD) during the same span. No return to pre-event baseline is observed within allowed context [410,495]; N stabilizes at higher level after 460 but no opposing offset is seen before 495.
